_comment: CONTROL arm for the 2026-07-29 golden 50-station run.  Isolates ONE mechanism:
network.mw_wl.enable (the WL-1 MW-seeded wide-lane FLOAT pseudo-observation layer,
which folds rows into the normals).  Everything else — including the EWL/UWL decision
mw_wl_on          = carry_invariant && networkMwWlSeed()      (:459)  <- the ONLY thing changed
so the carried-DD MEMBERSHIP (which GPS L5 / Galileo third-band ambiguities are excluded
from the carry) is identical across the two arms.  The treatment is purely 'do the MW WL
float rows enter the normal equations'.
Hypothesis under test: in the treated arm, epoch 11 (tow 259500 — the first epoch WL-1
arms, min_arc_epochs = 10) shows a step change: D5 innovation flags 39 -> 877, post-fit
sigma0_code 3.62 -> 7.58, and the previously-descending robust clock spread (9.80 -> 9.13 m
over epochs 1-10) reverses and never recovers.  If this arm instead keeps sigma0_code near
3.5 and the clock spread keeps descending through epoch 31, the WL-1 float fold is the cause.
